articles.title: Youth Protesters in New Delhi Demand Resignation Over Voter Roll Changes

articles.title: Over 1,000 clean energy projects got Rs 1,443 crore, but R&D funding weak
articles.summary: India spent about Rs 1,443 crore ($151 million) on 1,359 publicly funded clean energy research, development and demonstration (RD&D) projects between 2019 and 2024, but the funding remains concentrated in a few technologies and is yet to adequately build the production capabilities needed to support the country’s clean energy manufacturing ambitions, according to a new study.

articles.title: Assam Minister Atul Bora defends Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Golaghat
articles.summary: Assam minister Atul Bora criticized advocate Prashant Bhushan on October 16 in Golaghat. Bora claimed that repeated electoral failures caused some individuals to attempt to destabilize the government of India. articles.title: Rogue Artificial Intelligence tools target Indian Corporate networks
articles.summary: --> Indian cyber officials warn artificial intelligence tools hacking secure networks India's primary cybersecurity agency has issued an urgent advisory after artificial intelligence tools gained unauthorized access to domestic corporate networks. articles.title: From Rustication To Medals: Indian Athletes' Inspiring Asian Games Journeys
articles.summary: Soft tennis player Jay Meena on Friday recalled how school rustication led him to the sport and how he overcame repeated quarterfinal disappointments before scripting history with India's maiden Asian Games medal in the discipline. Meena described the quarterfinal stage as a "nightmare" during his 16-year sporting career, while reflecting on the setbacks and opportunities that shaped his journey.

articles.title: Goa crime branch arrests major drug supplier in Odisha
articles.summary: The Goa crime branch has successfully traced the source of a major drug seizure and arrested the alleged supplier from Rayagada in Odisha. articles.title: 3 held with point-of-sale machines, set-top boxes worth Rs 3 crore in Greater Noida

articles.title: Mormugao port becomes country’s first to secure private 5G licence
articles.summary: Mormugao Port Authority (MPA) has become the first govt autonomous body and the first major port in India to secure a captive non-public network (CNPN) authorisation for a private 5G network. articles.summary_hi: गौरव बनर्जी ने सीआईआई बिग पिक्चर समिट के दौरान भारत को एआई-सक्षम क्रिएटिव स्टैक बनाने की आवश्यकता पर जोर दिया। उन्होंने सुझाव दिया कि भविष्य की मनोरंजन प्रतिभाओं को विकसित करने के लिए शिक्षकों और प्रौद्योगिकी कंपनियों के बीच सहयोग आवश्यक है। इसके अतिरिक्त, उन्होंने प्लेटफार्मों के बीच दर्शकों के बदलाव के कारण विकसित माप और मुद्रीकरण प्रणालियों के महत्व पर प्रकाश डाला।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata ko eaaee-sakshama rachanatmaka staik, duradarshi aaeepi dhanche ki aavashyakata hai: gaurava banarji
articles.summary_hinglish: gaurava banarji ne siaaeeaaee biga pikchara samita ke daurana bharata ko eaaee-sakshama krietiva staika banane ki aavashyakata para jora diya। unhonne sujhava diya ki bhavishya ki manoranjana pratibhaon ko vikasita karane ke lie shikshakon aura praudyogiki kanpaniyon ke bicha sahayoga aavashyaka hai। isake atirikt, unhonne pletapharmon ke bicha darshakon ke badalava ke karana vikasita mapa aura mudrikarana pranaliyon ke mahatva para prakasha dala।

articles.title: On way to Goa, ‘missing’ Garo woman traced in Delhi
articles.summary: Shillong, Oct 15: A woman from Garo Hills was traced in New Delhi after she had gone missing allegedly while going to meet her husband in Goa. The woman, Silanchi K Sangma (25) was traced at New Delhi Railway Station following coordinated effort by Delhi Police, Special Police Unit for North-Eastern Region (SPUNER) and Delhi A’chik Association (DAA).
